purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically diagnostic procedure set input (診療行為セット入力) component of the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCGK05 is a component of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system handling diagnostic procedure set input (診療行為セット入力). It manages screen-based entry of medical procedures, sets, and quantities for Japanese medical billing/receipt processing. The program handles file I/O for parameter and SPA screen data, with extensive screen navigation and input validation logic.

notable_features: 59 COPY statements referencing shared copybooks (.INC files)
353 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
Large working storage with extensive flag and index areas
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
MAX-LINE-VALUE 400 indicating large data processing capacity
SPA (scratchpad area) pattern typical of ORCA screen programs
verdict.notes: File is 6800 lines, 286KB - a substantial production program. Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding but decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake display. The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt software maintained by JMA. Source truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently. Version history in comments shows evolution from 2000 to 2009.
